dogecoin.text: @Coinsquare trades/withdrawals are still restricted on my account. This is unacceptable. Customer service won’t answer. Your customers lost money on Dogecoin last night because of your platform. Get it together and give me my money back.

@Coinsquare An investigation into the root cause of this mess is likely warranted. Hyping dogecoin and then restricting peoples accounts is suspicious. I want my money, and also answers @cbcmarketplace - how much money has been lost between Saturday and today?

@Coinsquare Well, I bought dogecoin but I’ve been unable to buy more because my account doesn’t work. Security is “reviewing” but how long will that take. People are losing money. How will you compensate us? Investing is a risk, yes, but not being able to exit? Your magnifying peoples risk.
